title: Backtest Run
description: Minimal top-level identity/provenance container for a rolling-origin backtest (Architecture Baseline section 9). Detailed execution and lineage content belongs to Backtest Fold and the entities it links to (ADR-009 decision 8); this schema intentionally does not embed folds or a backtesting configuration object. The Architecture Baseline does not enumerate further top-level Backtest Run fields beyond its role as the Fold container and its temporal_classification (section 5.5); additional fields, and the relationship direction to the common Job Run provenance record, remain an open Phase 0 schema-design question (see packages/contracts/README.md).
